final_prompt: Storm night, rain on closed louvred shutters, a carved Marquesan post, black sand on the floor. 16:9 two-shot, faces in three-quarter view: the woman from the first reference image (grey-green eyes, glossy true-black wavy curly hair, never blue, full lips, faint pale healed scar through her left eyebrow, about 34) and the man from the second reference image (tanned, ash-blond hair tied back loosely, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, about 47, devilishly handsome) sit facing each other in two worn leather armchairs, knees almost touching, faces apart, eyes locked, not blinking. She: black silk slip, bare shoulders, a diamond-and-emerald necklace. He: damp white linen shirt open at the collar. Sweat on both. She holds a burning match beside her wide-open eye, not touching it, burned almost to her fingers; his fingertips rest on the pulse inside her wrist. Crimson light through the shutters lays red-black bars across both; the flame lights her eye honey-gold. Bodies still, only flame and light move. Adult, charged, not explicit, no kiss. One quiet impossible detail, as if normal, nobody reacts: the shutters are straight, yet their shadow curves around them into the domed bars of a birdcage, closing to a ring above their heads.
surreal_detail: The window has ordinary straight louvred shutters, but the shadow they throw over the two of them bends into the curved bars of a domed birdcage, meeting in a ring above their heads. It is photographed as plain fact and nobody looks at it. This is #031 made into light: 'You and I are lovebirds, inseparables, / in a cage, waiting for the equinox.' The Russian word неразлучники means both 'inseparables' and lovebird parrots, so the cage is the verse's own. No birds appear, which keeps it underground rather than sweet. In motion the cage shadow holds still while lightning and the match flame move, so the body stays and the light moves (#081). The idea held in reserve is also from #031, «Лишь горим, не сгораючи» ('we only burn, without burning out'): a flame that never shortens the match. It works only in motion, so it stays out of this still to keep to one impossible detail.
one_line_for_elena: Storm night: Kira and Ule face each other in leather armchairs, staring without blinking; she holds a burning match by her open eye, his fingers on her pulse; straight shutters cast a birdcage shadow.
rule_check: 1) Kira is a lesbian, so there is no sex and no kiss: the prompt says 'faces apart' and 'no kiss'. The only touch is his fingertips on the pulse inside her wrist, which is power and recognition, not seduction. That keeps the scenario's 'recognition, not seduction'. PASS. 2) Explicitness: she wears a black silk slip with bare shoulders; he wears a damp linen shirt open at the collar. Nothing is frontal, no sex act is shown, and the prompt says 'not explicit'. I dropped the other design's 'thin wet' silk because of the see-through risk on qwen-uncensored. Bare shoulders are the limit. PASS. 3) The body stays and the light moves (#081): 'Bodies still, only flame and light move.' It animates as a near-still take with flame flicker and crimson shutter light; slow Kira 1.2x. PASS. 4) There is exactly one surreal detail, stated as normal with nobody reacting: the straight shutters cast a curved birdcage shadow. The lovebird shadows and the never-shortening match were left out to avoid a second detail. PASS. 5) The aesthetic is underground Atuona: storm, crimson and honey light, shutter-bar shadows, sweat, black sand, a carved Marquesan post. The emerald necklace is the #058 storm-night object from scene 14, already on her throat. There are no stock props (no glasses, phones or watches), it is not soap, and it is not glossy porn. PASS. 6) The frame is built from her lines. #061 gives the 'cage for two', sitting across from Him, 'Without blinking', and 'props them open with matches': the match is held at her wide-open eye but not touching it, so it does not read as self-harm. #031 gives 'lovebirds, inseparables, / in a cage': the birdcage shadow. PASS. 7) Cast: people are named only as 'the woman from the first reference image' and 'the man from the second reference image'. Kira has grey-green eyes, true-black hair stated as never blue, and a faint pale healed scar through her left eyebrow, about 34. Ule is tanned, ash-blond with hair tied back, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, about 47, devilishly handsome, and not weathered. PASS. Note: the scenario's Cast list still says 'blue-black hair'; the brief's 'never blue' rule was followed. Production: the prompt is 1241 characters, at or under the 1250 limit. It names no brands (the scenario's brand name for the necklace is left out), no celebrities and no text in the image. It is a single 16:9 still that can be made from the two references, in plain wording. PASS.

scores.notes: This is the stronger and safer frame. The faces are kept apart and the eyes locked, so the night stays 'recognition, not seduction'. The one touch is his fingertips on the pulse inside her wrist. That is power and reading her, it is not seduction, and it foreshadows #096's 'steady pulse'. The black silk slip with bare shoulders stays under the line and is plain enough that the bar shadows read clearly. The two worn leather armchairs are #061's 'comfortable cage for two... sit down across from Him' taken literally. The necklace is the #058 storm-night object from scene 14, already on her throat, so it earns its place: it sits on her body, it is not a stock prop. The surreal detail is the best of the two. Straight shutters throw a shadow that bends into a domed birdcage. The light itself does the impossible thing, which fits #081 ('the light moves'), and with no birds it does not turn sweet or toyish. Weaknesses: the island world is thin (no Marquesan carving, no black sand, by the designer's own admission), and the armchairs read slightly formal. Its 1244 characters spend a lot on identity text.

The hotter and more Atuona-textured frame: carved Marquesan posts, black sand, a wet low-backed slip and sweat on a bare back, honey match-light from below. Nothing breaches the rules, but two choices raise the risk. 'Faces a breath apart' in profile pulls the edit model toward a kiss, which the Kira-is-a-lesbian rule forbids. A 'thin wet crimson silk slip' on qwen-edit-uncensored, seen in profile, is likely to go see-through or frontal. The surreal detail is weaker. Two small lovebirds inside a birdcage shadow lean 'toyish or sweet', which her style file bans. It also doubles the cage, since the shutter bars are already the cage. Edit models also tend to draw a real cage and real birds instead of only a shadow. The profile two-shot loses Kira's grey-green eyes and eyebrow scar. 'Steadying' her wrist casts him as her helper, which carries less charge than reading her pulse. Its graftable strengths are the Marquesan post, the black sand and the honey flame-light, and all three are carried into the final.

final_prompt: Night still, 16:9. A dark wooden island bedroom: a carved Marquesan lintel in raking light; wet shutters lay bars of crimson and honey light; through one open shutter a black stormy sea breaks white under far lightning. Over the shoulder of the woman from the first reference image: she sits on the bed's edge in the right foreground, bare back and shoulders to camera, sweat on her pale skin, a crimson silk sheet gathered at her waist, glossy true-black wavy curly hair, face in near-profile so the faint pale healed hairline scar through her left eyebrow shows; she watches him without blinking, lips closed, in command. Facing her on white sheets kneels the man from the second reference image, handsome, about 47: tanned, ash-blond hair tied back loosely, golden stubble, white linen shirt open at the chest, sweat on his throat. He is perfectly still, living skin: right hand stopped in mid-air an inch from her jaw, not touching; lips parted; pale blue eyes locked on hers. No kiss. Around him, and only around him, a splash of seawater hangs motionless in the air, hundreds of drops stopped mid-flight, each holding a crimson glint; she ignores it. A bar of light crosses his chest and her shoulder blade. Film grain, deep shadow. No text.
surreal_detail: A splash of seawater hangs motionless in the air around Ule, and only around him: hundreds of drops stopped mid-flight in a dry bedroom, each holding a crimson glint. Kira ignores it. Through the open shutter behind him the real storm sea keeps breaking, so in the near-still take (Kling O3, least motion) the sea and lightning move, the glints shift and his chest barely rises, while the drops stay still. That contrast makes the freeze his alone. Source: #004 never reaches 'three'. She escapes instead («Наживка с крючка сорвалась. / Я шлепнулась и уплыла.», shot 6), and the poem ends «За брызги, прости, дорогой...» ('Forgive the splashes, dear...'), verified verbatim in CLOSE_READING_LITPROM.md l.124. In shot 31 the count lands and her old splash freezes around him.
one_line_for_elena: Night, shutter-bar crimson light, a storm sea in the window. Ule kneels frozen before Kira's bare back, his hand stopped an inch from her jaw. Seawater hangs still in the air around him only.
rule_check:
1 KIRA IS A LESBIAN: PASS. The prompt says 'No kiss'. His hand stops an inch from her jaw, 'not touching', so there is no contact at all. The only charge is eyes, breath, sweat and light. She holds the power (unblinking, 'in command') and he obeys the freeze. This is recognition, not seduction.
2 EXPLICITNESS: PASS. Her bare back and shoulders face the camera, seen from behind. A crimson silk sheet gathered at her waist fixes the lower line. Her front is never shown. His linen shirt is open at the chest only. No sex act and no frontal nudity.
3 BODY STAYS, LIGHT MOVES (#081): PASS. He is 'perfectly still'. She sits still. Shutter bars, far lightning and crimson glints in the drops carry the light. Motion note for the video pass: Kling O3, least motion, a near-still take and not a freeze-frame. Only his breath, the lightning, the sea in the window and the glints may move. The suspended drops must not fall.
4 ONE QUIET SURREAL DETAIL: PASS. The splash hangs motionless around him only, and she ignores it. The storm sea outside is real weather, not a second impossible thing. The other design's frost and white breath were deliberately not grafted, because they would make a second impossible detail.
5 UNDERGROUND ATUONA AESTHETIC: PASS. Crimson and honey shutter bars, sweat, storm, a carved Marquesan lintel (#098 light on the lintel, non-explicit image only), crimson silk, deep shadow and film grain. No stock props: no glasses, phones or watches.
6 ROOTED IN HER LINES: PASS. #004 «Море волнуется раз / два» is the storm sea plus the count, and the missing 'three' lands on him as the freeze. The text card 'Ule freezes.' is #098. «За брызги, прости, дорогой...» (#004) is the frozen splash. 'without blinking' is #061/#063. The open linen shirt continues shot 25 («расхристана»).
7 CAST: PASS. People are named only as 'the woman from the first reference image' and 'the man from the second reference image'. Kira: glossy true-black wavy curly hair (never blue), pale skin, the faint pale healed hairline scar through her left eyebrow. She is turned toward him in near-profile, so her left side and the scar face the camera. Ule: handsome, about 47, tanned, ash-blond hair tied back loosely, golden stubble, pale blue eyes. Grey-green eyes and full lips come from the reference because of the length limit.
PRODUCTION: PASS. 1247 characters by wc -c (cap 1250). No brands, celebrities or text. The word 'Atuona' was removed to avoid rendered text, and 'like a statue' was replaced with 'perfectly still, living skin' to avoid stone or bronze skin. The wording is plain. A refusal is final: no rewording and no re-routing, and any redesign goes to Elena first.
FRAMES TO REJECT: drops that read as rain, sweat spray or bokeh rather than a splash hanging around him; her front shown; any contact or kiss; stone-like skin on him; navy hair; Kira's likeness lost.

scores.notes: This design wins. There is no kiss and no contact (his hand stops an inch from her jaw), Kira's back is the only nudity, and he stays clothed in an open linen shirt. The power runs the right way: he kneels and obeys the count while she holds it without blinking (#061). The surreal detail comes from her own poem. I checked that «За брызги, прости, дорогой...» is verbatim #004 (CLOSE_READING_LITPROM.md l.124), so the splash she made escaping in shot 6 now hangs frozen around him. The take also animates well: the drops stay still while the crimson glints move. Weak points: no storm sea is on screen, so 'The sea is stormy' is never seen. Her lower body is not described, which leaves qwen-uncensored room to show more. 'Like a statue' could turn his skin to stone, and the word 'Atuona' could be rendered as text. The drops may also come out as rain or bokeh. 1231 characters.

The rules are kept: no kiss, his hand stops above her shoulder blade, and only her back is shown. But a bare-chested Ule kneeling close, with the sheet low at her waist, puts more nudity pressure on qwen-uncensored. Its best ideas are the storm sea in the open shutter, which shows 'The sea is stormy' literally, the crimson silk sheet, and the sweat on her back. All three are grafted into the final prompt. The frost is the weak point. It is a pun on the English word 'freeze' (her Russian «замри» means 'be still', not 'turn to ice'). It also undoes his arc: in shot 24 his tear is melted ice (#043), so freezing him again goes backwards. It risks an 'ice king' fantasy look that cools the heat she asked for, and the white breath may read as smoke. Kira is in lost profile, so the left-eyebrow scar and her likeness are lost. Two #098 quotes it cites, 'shoulders locked mid-motion' and 'must hold weight', do not appear in any repo file, so they are unverified. 1232 characters.

final_prompt: Night, black volcanic-stone room, a carved Marquesan post behind them. The only light: crimson and honey bars rising from low shutter slats, as if from underground. Close shot from behind her left shoulder. The woman from the first reference image (same face, glossy jet-black wavy curly hair, pale skin, full lips, faint pale healed scar through her left eyebrow, about 34) turns her face into the neck of the man from the second reference image: left profile, grey-green eye open, unblinking, lips parted a breath from his skin, not touching, not a kiss, as if she just spoke his name. Her black silk slip has fallen to the small of her back: bare shoulders and back wet with sweat, her chest pressed to him, hidden from camera. Her fist holds his open white linen collar. He (same face, tanned, ash-blond hair tied back loosely, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, about 47, devilishly handsome) stands utterly still, head tipped back against the carving, throat bared, sweating, eyes open, one hand flat on her bare shoulder blade. Bodies still, only the light moves. One quiet impossible detail, shown as normal, nobody reacts: where her breath meets his hot throat, fine white frost spreads in thin forking lines, like frost on a winter window.
surreal_detail: Her breath leaves frost on a man's hot, sweating throat on a tropical night. Where her breath meets his skin, fine white frost grows in thin branching lines, like frost on a winter window. Neither of them notices. The idea is from #040, the poem voiced in this shot: «Я - та иная Прохлада, / Что на твоем пути» ("I am that other Coolness on your path"). The branching makes the frost #098's "Not a request. / A fork." It also reverses shot 2's frost oval (#044): there her lips melted ice on glass; here her breath makes ice on living skin. It continues 24's "trickle of melted ice" (#043) and starts 31's "Ule freezes." (#098) at his throat. This replaces the second design's two-shadows idea, which would use up shot 35's "two versions of the same woman" too early. In motion, the frost and the light are the only things that move; it creeps slowly while both bodies stay still.
one_line_for_elena: Crimson underground light; her bare back to camera, her face in his neck, lips a breath from his skin, his head thrown back; where her breath touches his throat, winter-window frost grows.
rule_check: 1 KIRA IS A LESBIAN, NO KISS: PASS. Her lips are 'a breath from his skin, not touching, not a kiss'. This fixes the verse design, where 'her mouth touches his throat' would read as a neck kiss. The frost now comes from her BREATH, not from her mouth on his skin. Touch is limited to her fist at his collar, his palm on her shoulder blade, and her chest against him. The heat is power, his bared throat, sweat, an unblinking eye and light, which is recognition, not seduction. Her hand stays off his throat, so shot 32 keeps its own beat. QA: reject any take where her lips meet his skin. 2 EXPLICITNESS: PASS. The camera is behind her left shoulder. The slip has fallen only to the small of her back, so bare shoulders and back are the limit. Her chest is 'pressed to him, hidden from camera'. Nothing frontal and no sex act. QA: reject any side or frontal reveal outright; do not re-word around it. 3 THE BODY STAYS, THE LIGHT MOVES: PASS. 'Stands utterly still', 'Bodies still, only the light moves'. In the take only the shutter bars and the creeping frost move. 4 ONE QUIET IMPOSSIBLE DETAIL: PASS. Exactly one, the frost from her breath, 'shown as normal, nobody reacts'. The prompt contains nothing else impossible. QA: the frost must look like window frost, not a rash, mould or an ice crust. 5 UNDERGROUND ATUONA: PASS. Black volcanic stone, a carved Marquesan post, crimson and honey shutter bars rising from below as an underworld, sweat, black silk, white linen. The verse design's floor lamp is gone, because it was a stock prop under her no-props rule. 6 HER CONTENT: PASS. #040 'As if in the underworld / one password waits for us' becomes the light rising from below and a name spoken into his neck. #040's 'Coolness' becomes the frost. #098 'Ule', 'Not a whisper… open, unmasked' becomes her parted lips and open, unblinking eye, with her face in his neck so the word is spoken off-face (no lip-sync, scenario production note). #098 'Not a request. / A fork.' becomes the forking frost lines. 7 CAST: PASS. The woman is described first so the reference order matches the prompt order and the faces do not swap. Her hair is written 'glossy jet-black', following NOW.md's warning that 'blue-black' renders as blue. 'Not blue' was dropped because a negation can prime the colour. She has the scar through her left eyebrow, shown in left profile, and is about 34. He has ash-blond hair tied back, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, is about 47 and devilishly handsome. Grey-green eyes are kept; the pale skin, full lips and scar are kept. PRODUCTION: 1246 characters (measured), at or under 1250, about 1396 with the realism line, under the 1500 cap. Plain ASCII, no brand or celebrity names, no text in the image. People are named only by reference image. Engines: Seedream v5 pro edit and qwen-edit-uncensored only. If either refuses, that is final, and the shot is redesigned only with her OK, never re-routed (the earlier k30 was refused twice on GPT Image 2.5).

scores.notes: The strongest idea. The frost comes from #040, the same poem the shot voices: 'I am that other Coolness on your path', and she returns 'as cold morning rain'. The crystals branch, so they also carry #098's 'A fork'. It reverses shot 2's frost oval and leads into 31's 'Ule freezes'. His bared, sweating throat with her fist in his collar is a real power reversal, which is the hottest version of 'recognition, not seduction'. The rules score is lower because of two lines. 'Mouth hidden at his pulse' and 'where her mouth touches his throat' put her mouth on his skin, which an image reads as a kiss on the neck and breaks hard rule 1. 'Straps fallen' with her pressed against him also invites a side reveal. Smaller points: the man is described before the woman, which risks swapping the two references. The floor lamp is a stock prop, which breaks her no-generic-props rule. The frost could read as a rash.

The safest framing for the rules. 'Lips parted a breath from his skin, not a kiss' keeps hard rule 1. The camera behind her left shoulder keeps her chest away from the lens and shows the scar in her left eyebrow. The black volcanic-stone room with shutter bars is a better underworld than a lamp. One woman casting two shadows is an elegant way to show the fork. Against it: edit models are unreliable with shadow logic and tend to draw a third person or two identical shadows. It also spends shot 35's image ('two versions of the same woman') five shots early. It is less tied to #040, the poem this shot voices. The heat is more static: he only looks past her.
